$comment: Path-to-layer map for commitwork's own flow graph (flow/dfd-adapter.mjs validateLayerMap, layerOf; pass it to fromFlowGraph as `layers`). Layers are named by maturity of the data, in pipeline order. Rule source: monitor/README.md 'The sweep pipeline' (sweep.mjs runs bin/commitwork.mjs per repo into reports/sweep-<stamp>/; rollup.mjs reads the batch and writes rollup.json, dashboard.html, REMEDIATION.md, lifecycle.json, history/; issue ingest, timeline, export-overwatch and projectstatus follow) and monitor/README.md on extractors.mjs ('one reader per artifact'). First matching rule wins. A path no rule names has no layer: the map claims only the pipeline it was read from, not every module in the tree.
